declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore
declarations.actual_checked_signature: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore (l r : Nat) : Type
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source: abbrev StoredCore (l r : ℕ) := StoredMatrix l (2 * r)
declarations.reconstruction: Literal storage alias: l rows of real vectors with 2*r entries, representing physical bit then right-bond index.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.denoteCore
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.denoteCore {l r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l r) : QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Core l r
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
def denoteCore {l r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l r) : Core l r :=
  fun a out => denote A a (finProdFinEquiv out)
declarations.reconstruction: Literal reindexing: A[a][bit*r+b] on the whole Fin l × (Fin 2 × Fin r) carrier; no truncation or padding.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredChain
declarations.actual_checked_signature: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredChain : Nat → Nat → Nat → Type
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
inductive StoredChain : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Type
  | nil (r : ℕ) : StoredChain 0 r r
  | cons {n l m r : ℕ} (head : StoredCore l m) (tail : StoredChain n m r) :
      StoredChain (n + 1) l r
declarations.reconstruction: Dependent actual stored chain: nil has length 0 and equal boundaries r; cons joins l→m core to length-n m→r tail, yielding length n+1 l→r.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.denoteChain
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.denoteChain {n l r : Nat} :
  QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredChain n l r → QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Chain n l r
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
def denoteChain : {n l r : ℕ} → StoredChain n l r → Chain n l r
  | _, _, _, .nil r => .nil r
  | _, _, _, .cons A C => .cons (denoteCore A) (denoteChain C)

/-- Each callback is invoked once; its arithmetic cost remains charged. -/
declarations.reconstruction: Structural storage forgetting, preserving length, every intermediate dimension, emitted-bit order and terminal dimension.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.sumEntries
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.sumEntries {k : Nat} :
  (Fin k → QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run Real) → QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run Real
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
noncomputable def sumEntries : {k : ℕ} → (Fin k → Run ℝ) → Run ℝ
  | 0, _ => pure 0
  | k + 1, f => do
      let first ← f 0
      let rest ← sumEntries (fun i : Fin k => f i.succ)
      StoredGivens.add first rest
declarations.reconstruction: Literal recursion: k=0 returns zero at zero cost; k+1 evaluates f 0, recursively evaluates successor indices, then charges one addition. There are k additions including the last addition to zero.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.sumEntries_value
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
theorem sumEntries_value {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Run ℝ) :
    (sumEntries f).value = ∑ i, (f i).value := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [sumEntries, pure, Run.pure]
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [sumEntries, bind, Run.bind, StoredGivens.add, charge]
      rw [ih, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
declarations.reconstruction: Value equals the finite sum of the supplied Run values for every k, including zero.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.sumEntries_cost_le
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.sumEntries_cost_le {k : Nat}
  (f : Fin k → QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run Real) (op : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Op) (B : Nat)
  (bound : ∀ (i : Fin k), @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.cost Real (f i) op) B) :
  @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat
    (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.cost Real (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.sumEntries k f) op)
    (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat) k
      (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat) B
        (QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.tick QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Op.field op)))
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
theorem sumEntries_cost_le {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Run ℝ) (op : Op) (B : ℕ)
    (bound : ∀ i, (f i).cost op ≤ B) :
    (sumEntries f).cost op ≤ k * (B + tick .field op) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [sumEntries, pure, Run.pure]
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [sumEntries, bind, Run.bind, StoredGivens.add, charge, Pi.add_apply]
      have first := bound 0
      have rest := ih (fun i => f i.succ) (fun i => bound i.succ)
      rw [Nat.succ_mul]
      omega

/-- Multiply the residual into a single bit-preserving output entry. -/
declarations.reconstruction: Logical premise: uniform bound for the chosen operation counter on every callback Run. Conclusion k*(B+one field tick). This does not verify that an arbitrary external callback honestly accounts for its evaluation.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionEntry
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionEntry {l m r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l m) (R : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.StoredMatrix m r)
  (a : Fin l) (out : Prod.{0, 0} (Fin (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2)))) (Fin r)) :
  QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run Real
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
noncomputable def absorptionEntry {l m r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l m)
    (R : StoredMatrix m r) (a : Fin l) (out : Fin 2 × Fin r) : Run ℝ :=
  sumEntries fun b => do
    let x ← StoredThinLQ.entry A a (finProdFinEquiv (out.1, b))
    let y ← StoredThinLQ.entry R b out.2
    StoredGivens.mul x y
declarations.reconstruction: Bit-preserving local contraction: sum over b in Fin m of stored A[a,bit*m+b] times stored R[b,c]. Each summand charges four stored reads, one multiplication and the recursion one addition.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionEntry_value
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionEntry_value {l m r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l m) (R : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.StoredMatrix m r)
  (a : Fin l) (out : Prod.{0, 0} (Fin (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2)))) (Fin r)) :
  @Eq.{1} Real
    (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.value Real
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionEntry l m r A R a out))
    (@QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.absorb l m r (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.denoteCore l m A)
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.denote m r R) a out)
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
theorem absorptionEntry_value {l m r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l m)
    (R : StoredMatrix m r) (a : Fin l) (out : Fin 2 × Fin r) :
    (absorptionEntry A R a out).value = absorb (denoteCore A) (denote R) a out := by
  rw [absorptionEntry, sumEntries_value]
  rfl
declarations.reconstruction: Exact equality to semantic absorb at every a and output bit/bond pair, not an approximate value or projected sector.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionEntry_cost_le
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionEntry_cost_le {l m r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l m) (R : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.StoredMatrix m r)
  (a : Fin l) (out : Prod.{0, 0} (Fin (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2)))) (Fin r))
  (op : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Op) :
  @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat
    (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.cost Real
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionEntry l m r A R a out) op)
    (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat) m
      (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat)
        (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat)
          (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 4) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 4)))
          (QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.tick QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Op.read op))
        (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat)
          (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2)))
          (QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.tick QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Op.field op))))
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
theorem absorptionEntry_cost_le {l m r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l m)
    (R : StoredMatrix m r) (a : Fin l) (out : Fin 2 × Fin r) (op : Op) :
    (absorptionEntry A R a out).cost op ≤ m * (4 * tick .read op + 2 * tick .field op) := by
  have h := sumEntries_cost_le (fun b => do
    let x ← StoredThinLQ.entry A a (finProdFinEquiv (out.1, b))
    let y ← StoredThinLQ.entry R b out.2
    StoredGivens.mul x y) op (4 * tick .read op + tick .field op) (by
      intro b
      simp [bind, Run.bind, StoredGivens.mul, charge]
      omega)
  simpa only [absorptionEntry, Nat.add_assoc, ← two_mul] using h
declarations.reconstruction: For each operation counter, upper bound m*(4 read ticks+2 field ticks), with no rank/nonzero premise.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionEntry {l m r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l m) (R : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.StoredMatrix m r)
  (a : Fin l) (out : Prod.{0, 0} (Fin (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2)))) (Fin r)) :
  QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run Real
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
noncomputable def absorption {l m r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l m)
    (R : StoredMatrix m r) : Run (StoredCore l r) :=
  materialize (fun a j => absorptionEntry A R a (finProdFinEquiv.symm j))
declarations.reconstruction: Materializes every local contraction once in l × (2*r) stored output; nested collect charges storage passes and preserves bit/bond relabeling.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption_value
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption_value {l m r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l m) (R : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.StoredMatrix m r) :
  @Eq.{1} (QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Core l r)
    (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.denoteCore l r
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.value (QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l r)
        (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption l m r A R)))
    (@QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.absorb l m r (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.denoteCore l m A)
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.denote m r R))
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
theorem absorption_value {l m r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l m)
    (R : StoredMatrix m r) :
    denoteCore (absorption A R).value = absorb (denoteCore A) (denote R) := by
  ext a out
  simp only [denoteCore, absorption, materialize, denote, collect_value,
    Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact absorptionEntry_value A R a out
declarations.reconstruction: Whole-core function equality between denoted actual stored output and semantic absorb.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionBudget
declarations.actual_checked_signature: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionBudget (l m r : Nat) : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Cost
declarations.actual_axiom_report: 'QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionBudget' does not depend on any axioms
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
def absorptionBudget (l m r : ℕ) : Cost := fun op =>
  l * (2 * r) * m * (4 * tick .read op + 2 * tick .field op) +
    (l * (2 * r) + l) * (2 * tick .read op + 2 * tick .write op)
declarations.reconstruction: Literal componentwise polynomial: 2*l*r*m*(4 read+2 field)+(2*l*r+l)*(2 read+2 write).

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption_cost_le
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption_cost_le {l m r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l m) (R : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.StoredMatrix m r)
  (op : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Op) :
  @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat
    (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.cost (QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l r)
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption l m r A R) op)
    (QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorptionBudget l m r op)
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
theorem absorption_cost_le {l m r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l m)
    (R : StoredMatrix m r) (op : Op) :
    (absorption A R).cost op ≤ absorptionBudget l m r op := by
  rw [absorption, materialize_cost]
  have h : (∑ a : Fin l, ∑ j : Fin (2 * r),
      (absorptionEntry A R a (finProdFinEquiv.symm j)).cost op) ≤
      l * (2 * r) * (m * (4 * tick .read op + 2 * tick .field op)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _a : Fin l, ∑ _j : Fin (2 * r),
          m * (4 * tick .read op + 2 * tick .field op) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro a _
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        exact absorptionEntry_cost_le A R a _ op
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  simp only [absorptionBudget]
  nlinarith
declarations.reconstruction: Uniform operationwise upper bound on the actual absorption Run. It is not equality to the budget nor a bit-runtime claim.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.CoreResult
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.CoreResult {l r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l r) : Type
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
structure CoreResult {l r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l r) where
  R : StoredMatrix l (min l (2 * r))
  Q : StoredCore (min l (2 * r)) r
  factorization : denoteCore A = denote R * denoteCore Q
  orthogonal : denoteCore Q * (denoteCore Q).transpose = 1
declarations.reconstruction: Produced bundle: stored R of l × min(l,2r), stored Q of min(l,2r) × 2r, exact factorization and row orthogonality. These proofs are fields of an output, not assumptions of factorCore.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.factorCore
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
noncomputable def factorCore {l r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l r) : Run (CoreResult A) :=
  let result := StoredThinLQ.compile A
  ⟨{ R := result.value.R, Q := result.value.Q,
     factorization := by
       ext a out
       exact congrFun (congrFun (StoredThinLQ.compile_correct A).1 a) (finProdFinEquiv out),
     orthogonal := by
       ext a b
       have h := congrFun (congrFun (StoredThinLQ.compile_correct A).2 a) b
       simp only [_root_.Matrix.mul_apply, _root_.Matrix.transpose_apply] at h ⊢
       exact (finProdFinEquiv.sum_comp (fun j =>
         denote result.value.Q a j * denote result.value.Q b j)).trans h }, result.cost⟩
declarations.reconstruction: Actual StoredThinLQ.compile output, reindexed into physical bit/right bond. l≤2r dispatch uses transpose, rectangular adjacent Givens, prefix extraction; tall l>2r returns A and materialized identity. Dimension comparison is charged. Zero/deficient data do not change the chosen inner dimension.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.Result
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.Result {n l r : Nat}
  (C : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredChain n l r) : Type
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
structure Result {n l r : ℕ} (C : StoredChain n l r) where
  rank : ℕ
  residual : StoredMatrix l rank
  canonical : StoredChain n rank r
  rightCanonical : RightCanonical (denoteChain canonical)
  rankReduced : RankReduced (denoteChain C) (denoteChain canonical)
  action : ∀ x, contract (denoteChain C) x = denote residual * contract (denoteChain canonical) x
  rank_le : rank ≤ l

/-- Read the input tag/payload and allocate the output chain node. -/
declarations.reconstruction: Produced bundle indexed by original chain: concrete rank, stored residual, concrete stored canonical chain, RightCanonical, structural RankReduced, action for all words, and rank≤original left dimension.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.nodeBudget
declarations.actual_checked_signature: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.nodeBudget : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Cost
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source: def nodeBudget : Cost := 3 • tick .read + 3 • tick .write
declarations.reconstruction: Literal three read plus three write ticks. This accounting convention charges chain tag/payload and allocation; it is not measured wall-clock time.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.canonicalize
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
noncomputable def canonicalize : {n l r : ℕ} → (C : StoredChain n l r) → Run (Result C)
  | _, _, _, .nil r =>
      let I := StoredRectangularGivens.identity r
      ⟨{ rank := r, residual := I.value, canonical := .nil r,
         rightCanonical := trivial, rankReduced := .nil r,
         action := fun _ => by simp [denoteChain, contract, I, StoredRectangularGivens.identity_value],
         rank_le := le_rfl }, nodeBudget + I.cost⟩
  | _, l, _, .cons A C =>
      let tailResult := canonicalize C
      let absorbed := absorption A tailResult.value.residual
      let headResult := factorCore absorbed.value
      ⟨{ rank := min l (2 * tailResult.value.rank), residual := headResult.value.R,
         canonical := .cons headResult.value.Q tailResult.value.canonical,
         rightCanonical := ⟨headResult.value.orthogonal, tailResult.value.rightCanonical⟩,
         rankReduced := .cons tailResult.value.rankReduced,
         action := by
           intro x
           change slice (denoteCore A) x.1 * contract (denoteChain C) x.2 =
             denote headResult.value.R *
               (slice (denoteCore headResult.value.Q) x.1 *
                 contract (denoteChain tailResult.value.canonical) x.2)
           rw [tailResult.value.action, ← _root_.Matrix.mul_assoc, ← absorb_slice]
           have hs : slice (absorb (denoteCore A) (denote tailResult.value.residual)) x.1 =
               denote headResult.value.R * slice (denoteCore headResult.value.Q) x.1 := by
             rw [← absorption_value]
             ext a b
             exact congrFun (congrFun headResult.value.factorization a) (x.1, b)
           rw [hs, _root_.Matrix.mul_assoc],
         rank_le := min_le_left _ _ },
       nodeBudget + tailResult.cost + absorbed.cost + headResult.cost⟩
declarations.reconstruction: Literal structural tail-first producer: nil returns materialized identity and nil at same terminal rank; cons recursively canonicalizes tail, materializes absorption of tail residual, factorizes it, joins actual Q and actual tail. Adds node, tail, absorption and factor costs.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.canonicalize_maxBond_le
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.canonicalize_maxBond_le {n l r : Nat}
  (C : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredChain n l r) :
  @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat
    (@QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.maxBond n
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.Result.rank n l r C
        (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.value (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.Result n l r C)
          (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.canonicalize n l r C)))
      r
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.denoteChain n
        (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.Result.rank n l r C
          (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.value (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.Result n l r C)
            (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.canonicalize n l r C)))
        r
        (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.Result.canonical n l r C
          (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.value (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.Result n l r C)
            (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.canonicalize n l r C)))))
    (@QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.maxBond n l r
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.denoteChain n l r C))
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
theorem canonicalize_maxBond_le {n l r : ℕ} (C : StoredChain n l r) :
    maxBond (denoteChain (canonicalize C).value.canonical) ≤ maxBond (denoteChain C) :=
  (canonicalize C).value.rankReduced.maxBond_le
declarations.reconstruction: Largest dimension of actual output chain, including initial and terminal boundaries, is at most that of actual input. Produced RankReduced supplies the proof.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption_total_cost_le
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption_total_cost_le {l m r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l m) (R : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.StoredMatrix m r) :
  @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat
    (QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredRectangularGivens.total
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.cost (QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l r)
        (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.absorption l m r A R)))
    (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat)
      (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat)
        (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat)
          (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat)
            (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat)
              (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 12) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 12))) l)
            m)
          r)
        (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat)
          (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat)
            (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 8) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 8))) l)
          r))
      (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat)
        (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 4) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 4))) l))
declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
theorem absorption_total_cost_le {l m r : ℕ} (A : StoredCore l m)
    (R : StoredMatrix m r) :
    StoredRectangularGivens.total (absorption A R).cost ≤
      12 * l * m * r + 8 * l * r + 4 * l := by
  have hf := absorption_cost_le A R .field
  have hs := absorption_cost_le A R .sqrt
  have ha := absorption_cost_le A R .angle
  have ht := absorption_cost_le A R .trig
  have hc := absorption_cost_le A R .compare
  have hr := absorption_cost_le A R .read
  have hw := absorption_cost_le A R .write
  have he := absorption_cost_le A R .emit
  simp [absorptionBudget, tick] at hf hs ha ht hc hr hw he
  simp only [StoredRectangularGivens.total]
  nlinarith
declarations.reconstruction: Total of all eight counters is at most 12*l*m*r+8*l*r+4*l. No normalization/full-rank input.

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.factorCore_total_cost_le
declarations.actual_checked_signature:
QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.factorCore_total_cost_le {l r : Nat}
  (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.StoredCore l r) (D : Nat) (hl : @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat l D)
  (hr : @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat r D) :
  @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat
    (QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredRectangularGivens.total
      (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredGivens.Run.cost (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.CoreResult l r A)
        (@QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredTensorTrain.factorCore l r A)))
    (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat)

theorem canonicalize_total_cost_le {n l r : ℕ} (C : StoredChain n l r) (D : ℕ)
    (bound : maxBond (denoteChain C) ≤ D) :
    StoredRectangularGivens.total (canonicalize C).cost ≤
      n * (176 * D ^ 3 + 116 * D ^ 2 + 29 * D + 8) + 5 * D ^ 2 + 4 * D + 6 := by
  induction C with
  | nil r =>
      have hr : r ≤ D := bound
      simp only [canonicalize, total_add, identity_total_cost, Nat.zero_mul, zero_add]
      have node : StoredRectangularGivens.total nodeBudget = 6 := by
        simp [nodeBudget, StoredRectangularGivens.total, tick]
      rw [node]
      have square := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hr 2
      omega
  | @cons n l m r A C ih =>
      have hl : l ≤ D := (max_le_iff.mp bound).1
      have ht : maxBond (denoteChain C) ≤ D := (max_le_iff.mp bound).2
      have hm : m ≤ D := by
        cases C with
        | nil r => exact ht
        | cons B C => exact (max_le_iff.mp ht).1
      have hr : (canonicalize C).value.rank ≤ D := (canonicalize C).value.rank_le.trans hm
      have tail := ih ht
      have absorbed := absorption_total_cost_le A (canonicalize C).value.residual
      have absorbBound : 12 * l * m * (canonicalize C).value.rank +
          8 * l * (canonicalize C).value.rank + 4 * l ≤
          12 * D ^ 3 + 8 * D ^ 2 + 4 * D := by
        calc
          _ ≤ 12 * D * D * D + 8 * D * D + 4 * D := by gcongr
          _ = _ := by ring
      have head := factorCore_total_cost_le (absorption A (canonicalize C).value.residual).value D hl hr
      simp only [canonicalize, total_add]
      have node : StoredRectangularGivens.total nodeBudget = 6 := by
        simp [nodeBudget, StoredRectangularGivens.total, tick]
      rw [node]
      nlinarith

/-- The output's semantic boundary is obtained from its stored residual. -/
declarations.reconstruction: Logical premise maxBond(denoteChain C)≤D, covering every actual bond and both boundaries. Total actual cost at most n*(176D^3+116D^2+29D+8)+5D^2+4D+6.

declarations.exact_formal_declaration_source:
theorem canonicalize_refines {n l r : ℕ} (C : StoredChain n l r) :
    (canonicalize C).value.toSemantic = ConstructiveTensorTrain.canonicalize (denoteChain C) := by
  induction C with
  | nil r =>
      simp only [canonicalize, Result.toSemantic, denoteChain,
        ConstructiveTensorTrain.canonicalize, StoredRectangularGivens.identity_value]
  | @cons n l m r A C ih =>
      change _ = semanticStep (denoteCore A) (ConstructiveTensorTrain.canonicalize (denoteChain C))
      rw [← ih]
      have hR := (factorCore_R (absorption A (canonicalize C).value.residual).value).trans
        (congrArg (fun B : Core l (canonicalize C).value.rank =>
          (ConstructiveTensorTrain.factorCore B).R)
          (absorption_value A (canonicalize C).value.residual))
      have hQ := (factorCore_Q (absorption A (canonicalize C).value.residual).value).trans
        (congrArg (fun B : Core l (canonicalize C).value.rank =>
          (ConstructiveTensorTrain.factorCore B).Q)
          (absorption_value A (canonicalize C).value.residual))
      simp only [canonicalize, semanticStep, Result.toSemantic, denoteChain,
        hR, hQ]
declarations.reconstruction: Equality of the ENTIRE converted dependent Result to the deterministic semantic canonicalize output, including rank, residual and canonical chain (proof fields equal by Lean proof irrelevance). Does not identify costs with semantic producer; not uniqueness among all right-canonical factorizations.

reconstruction.typing_inputs: All n,l,m,r,k,D,B are natural dimensions/budgets; Fin carriers and stored vectors/chains are dependent typing data. Scalars are exact reals. No positivity of dimensions, rank fullness, nonzero pivots or normalized state is a standing premise.

logical_inputs.Result.toSemantic: A Result C argument carrying its proof fields; this is a forgetful conversion, while canonicalize produces them.

expanded_bundles.CoreResult: k=min l (2*r); R:StoredMatrix l k; Q:StoredCore k r; denoteCore A = denote R * denoteCore Q; denoteCore Q*(denoteCore Q).transpose=1.
expanded_bundles.Result: rank:Nat; residual:StoredMatrix l rank; canonical:StoredChain n rank r; RightCanonical(denoteChain canonical); RankReduced(denoteChain C)(denoteChain canonical); ∀ x:Word n, contract(denoteChain C)x=denote residual*contract(denoteChain canonical)x; rank≤l.
expanded_bundles.RightCanonical: nil:True; cons(A,C):A*A.transpose=1 AND RightCanonical C. Orthogonality sums over both physical bit and every right-bond label.
expanded_bundles.RankReduced: nil r relates nil r to nil r. cons relates original left dimension l and tail C to Q with left dimension min l (2*mprime) and tail D, provided RankReduced C D. Terminal bond unchanged. This is a dimension recurrence, not minimal algebraic rank.
expanded_bundles.semantic_Result: rank:Nat; residual:Matrix(Fin l)(Fin rank) Real; canonical:Chain n rank r; rightCanonical; rankReduced; all-word matrix action. No rank_le field in the semantic bundle.
expanded_bundles.Run: value:alpha and cost:Op→Nat; pure returns zero cost, bind adds costs and applies continuation to actual value.
expanded_bundles.mass_and_chainMass: mass v=∑i v(i)^2. chainMass C v=∑x:Word n ∑j:Fin r ((vecMul v (contract C x)) j)^2. Word 0=Unit; Word(n+1)=Fin2×Word n. contract(nil)=identity; contract(cons)=slice(head,first-bit)*contract(tail,remaining-word).

reconstruction.definition_kind: Definitions are literal operational/reindexing/forgetful bodies. Stored deterministic producers do not use a factorization-existence theorem to select data. Noncomputable exact-real operations and standard classical axioms are not a finite-bit implementation certificate. No uniqueness of canonical TT gauges is asserted.

cost_model.total: Sum of all eight operation counters, no category omitted.
cost_model.storage: StoredMatrix N M = Vector (Vector Real M) N. Entry uses two charged reads. collect materializes Run results then projects values, charging two reads and two writes per element; materialize adds inner-entry and outer-row costs. Persistent replacement copies full vectors. Input stored-table acquisition/evaluation is a separate boundary.
omissions: initial external data/callback generation unless separately counted
gate synthesis, circuit emission for the TT itself, ancilla embedding, quantum execution, noise and readout
cost_model.nil_exact_total: 5*r^2+4*r+6, including full materialized identity and node cost. The uniform theorem uses 5*D^2+4*D+6 for n=0.

reconstruction.complete_carrier_boundary: Input/output have same terminal Fin r, not necessarily r=1. All-word action is equality of whole matrices; mass includes all terminal labels. Complete-carrier n=0,r=2 consumer has terminal component 0 zero and component 1 one, total mass one. Projecting terminal 0 would lose all mass in this witness.
reconstruction.exact_refinement_boundary: canonicalize_refines establishes actual returned semantic data equality, not an existential witness. It forgets storage and cost; it does not equate stored memory layout or counters with the uncosted semantic producer, prove minimal rank, uniqueness, circuit correctness or bit complexity.

private_helpers.exact_source:
private theorem total_add (a b : Cost) :
    StoredRectangularGivens.total (a + b) =
      StoredRectangularGivens.total a + StoredRectangularGivens.total b := by
  simp only [StoredRectangularGivens.total, Pi.add_apply]
  ring

private_helpers.exact_source:
private theorem identity_total_cost (r : ℕ) :
    StoredRectangularGivens.total (StoredRectangularGivens.identity r).cost =
      5 * r ^ 2 + 4 * r := by
  simp [StoredRectangularGivens.total, StoredRectangularGivens.identity_cost,
    StoredRectangularGivens.identityBudget, tick]
  ring

/-- The actual stored producer uses linear-in-length, cubic-in-bond work in
the declared exact-real model, including absorption, storage, and node costs. -/

private_helpers.name: semanticStep
private_helpers.exact_source:
private noncomputable def semanticStep {n l m r : ℕ} {C : Chain n m r}
    (A : Core l m) (tailResult : ConstructiveTensorTrain.Result C) :
    ConstructiveTensorTrain.Result (.cons A C) :=
  let headResult := ConstructiveTensorTrain.factorCore (absorb A tailResult.residual)
  { rank := min l (2 * tailResult.rank), residual := headResult.R,
    canonical := .cons headResult.Q tailResult.canonical,
    rightCanonical := ⟨headResult.orthogonal, tailResult.rightCanonical⟩,
    rankReduced := .cons tailResult.rankReduced,
    action := by
      intro x
      change slice A x.1 * contract C x.2 =
        headResult.R * (slice headResult.Q x.1 * contract tailResult.canonical x.2)
      rw [tailResult.action, ← _root_.Matrix.mul_assoc, ← absorb_slice]
      have hs : slice (absorb A tailResult.residual) x.1 =
          headResult.R * slice headResult.Q x.1 := by
        ext a b
        exact congrFun (congrFun headResult.factorization a) (x.1, b)
      rw [hs, _root_.Matrix.mul_assoc] }

/-- Exact data refinement, not just another witness of the same contract. -/

private_helper_roles.total_add: Rewrites eight-counter totals over pointwise addition; accounting proof only.
private_helper_roles.semanticStep: One semantic cons step for the exact-data induction, using actual semantic factorCore, produced tail proofs, bit-preserving absorb and matrix associativity.

producer_dependency_topology: StoredThinLQ.compile supplies actual R,Q with correctness and exact semantic factor refinement.
StoredRectangularGivens supplies materialized identity, fused elimination/log and replayed transform.
ConstructiveTensorTrain supplies deterministic semantic TT factorCore/canonicalize.
TensorTrainCanonical supplies literal core/chain/word/absorb/mass and residual_mass, plus structural RankReduced.maxBond_le.
canonicalize works tail→absorption→factor→cons; action composes tail action, absorb_slice, core factorization and matrix associativity.
